title: Spreading a specified generic product to finite domain factors
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian domain and $B$ a finite $A$-algebra. Let $K$ be a fraction field of $A$, $K'$ an extension field of $K$ with compatible $A$-algebra structure, and $L_j$ a finite family of $K'$-fields. Suppose the reduction of $(K\otimes_A B)\otimes_K K'$ is isomorphic as a $K'$-algebra to $\prod_j L_j$. Suppose a nonzero $c_0\in A$, a subalgebra $S_0\subset K'$ representing $A[1/c_0]$, and a finite etale subalgebra $A_0\subset K'$ over $S_0$ are specified, with fraction field $K'$ and surjective spectrum map. There are a nonzero $c\in A$ and a finite etale surjective domain algebra $A'$ over $A[1/c]$, with $K'$ as fraction field, and finite domain $A'$-algebras $D_j$ with fraction fields $L_j$. Their fraction-field algebra structures form both scalar towers $A'\to D_j\to L_j$ and $A'\to K'\to L_j$. The reduction of $B\otimes_A A'$ is isomorphic to $\prod_j D_j$ as an $A'$-algebra. The rings $A'$ and $D_j$ can be represented in the same universe as $A$. No purely inseparable or universal-homeomorphism assertion is part of this statement.

source.place: spreading product idempotents after spreading the finite separable extension

proof.text: Apply exists_spread_generic_product_embedding to obtain the finite etale surjective domain model A prime, its fraction field K prime, and an injective map from the reduced tensor algebra into the product L_j containing all coordinate idempotents and clearing denominators in each coordinate.

The reduced tensor algebra is finite over A prime: use Module.Finite.base_change, transport across Algebra.TensorProduct.commRight, and take the nilradical quotient. The maps A prime to L_j are injective by composing IsFractionRing.injective with the field map K prime to L_j.

Apply exists_finite_domain_factors_of_product_embedding to that finite algebra and product map. It constructs small coordinate-image domains, proves their fraction-field properties and the product equivalence. Combine these factors with the previously obtained base model and scalar towers to obtain the unchanged conclusion. Its finite-sum proof also handles the empty product.

theorem exists_spread_generic_product_domains
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsDomain A]
    (B : Type v) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Module.Finite A B]
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    (K' : Type (max u v)) [Field K'] [Algebra K K'] [Algebra A K']
    [IsScalarTower A K K']
    (r : ℕ) (L : Fin r → Type (max u v)) [∀ j, Field (L j)]
    [∀ j, Algebra K' (L j)]
    (hsplit :
      letI := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra (R := K) (A := K ⊗[A] B) (B := K')
      Nonempty ((((K ⊗[A] B) ⊗[K] K') ⧸
        nilradical ((K ⊗[A] B) ⊗[K] K')) ≃ₐ[K'] (∀ j, L j)))
    (c0 : A) (hc0 : c0 ≠ 0) (S0 : Subalgebra A K')
    [IsLocalization.Away c0 S0] (A0 : Subalgebra S0 K')
    [Module.Finite S0 A0] [Algebra.Etale S0 A0] [IsFractionRing A0 K']
    (hsurj : Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S0 A0)))) :
    ∃ (c : A) (A' : Type u) (_ : CommRing A') (_ : Algebra (Localization.Away c) A')
      (_ : Algebra A A') (_ : IsScalarTower A (Localization.Away c) A')
      (_ : IsDomain A') (_ : Algebra A' K'),
      c ≠ 0 ∧ Module.Finite (Localization.Away c) A' ∧
        Algebra.Etale (Localization.Away c) A' ∧ IsFractionRing A' K' ∧
        Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.Away c) A'))) ∧
        ∃ (D : Fin r → Type u) (_ : ∀ j, CommRing (D j))
          (_ : ∀ j, Algebra A' (D j)) (_ : ∀ j, Algebra (D j) (L j))
          (_ : ∀ j, Algebra A' (L j))
          (_ : ∀ j, IsScalarTower A' (D j) (L j))
          (_ : ∀ j, IsScalarTower A' K' (L j)),
          (∀ j, Module.Finite A' (D j) ∧ IsDomain (D j) ∧ IsFractionRing (D j) (L j)) ∧
          letI := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra (R := A) (A := B) (B := A')
          Nonempty (((B ⊗[A] A') ⧸ nilradical (B ⊗[A] A')) ≃ₐ[A'] (∀ j, D j))
